points.actor: 财政部长 Henry Paulson 与美联储主席 Ben Bernanke
points.decision: 2008年9月18日会见主要议员，提议7000亿美元银行体系紧急救助。
points.evidence: In a meeting on September 18, 2008, Treasury Secretary Henry Paulson and Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke met with key legislators to propose a $700 billion (~$1.03 trillion in 2025) emergency bailout of the banking system.

points.decision: 《紧急经济稳定法》（TARP）于2008年10月3日签署成为法律。
points.evidence: The Emergency Economic Stabilization Act, also called the Troubled Asset Relief Program (TARP), was signed into law on October 3, 2008.
